metadata.description: Build, render, and publish 3D models with headless Blender scripting and Three.js web viewers — a battle-tested skill distilled from a real AI-driven modelling project.

plugins.name: blender-web-3d
plugins.description: Build, render, and publish Blender models as stunning, fast Three.js web experiences: headless edit scripts, Blender 5.x recipes, gltf-transform meshopt pipeline, AgX look-dev, custom GLSL shaders and material patches, adaptive quality, runtime batching, baked lightmaps — plus a runnable demo model and viewer template.
